sanafe_projection_scope: spiking backbone + spiking SSD extra feature layers only; dense SSD classification/regression prediction heads excluded
sanafe_projection_activity_source: measured per-layer activity from the trained Event-SNN DSEC benchmark
sanafe_projection_mapping_note: Layer-aggregated proxy simulation, not an exact neuron/synapse placement. Whole-layer energy is represented by scaled proxy hardware events; latency uses an average 1024-neuron/core parallel-workload projection. Core/chip capacity values are naive state-capacity estimates and are not the number of cores used by the compact proxy simulation.
sanafe_projection_packet_model: one-hop Loihi-like packet estimate; packets/input-spike = ceil(avg spike-triggered synapse fanout / 1024), capped at destination core count
